title: Ensure pam_unix does not include nullok
description: Audit a Linux server to verify that pam_unix.so entries in the fixed PAM files password-auth and system-auth do not contain the nullok argument.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

playbook_output.description: The emit step's <result> block contains the overall compliance result.

fields.name: compliant
fields.description: False if the nullok argument is present on any pam_unix.so line, true otherwise.

steps.name: Gather pam_unix.so lines
steps.function: Run a grep command to capture all lines matching the pam_unix.so pattern in the fixed files /etc/pam.d/password-auth and /etc/pam.d/system-auth.

steps.name: Check for nullok argument
steps.function: Examine the collected lines and determine whether any of them contain the word 'nullok'. Set _compliant to true only if no line includes nullok.

computations._compliant: True if no line in _grep_lines contains the string 'nullok', false otherwise.

steps.name: Emit audit result
steps.function: Print the compliance result. The output includes a boolean compliant flag and a human-readable PASS/FAIL message.

output_fields.message: {{ 'Compliant: PASS' if _compliant else 'Compliant: FAIL – nullok present' }}

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Data collection
phases.description: Gather the pam_unix.so configuration lines from both PAM files.

phases.name: Analysis and reporting
phases.description: Check the collected lines for the nullok argument and emit the compliance result.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
